entries.name: TacitPay8244
entries.description: One version of the anon.wei web app stored as contract code (ERC-8244). html() returns the page from immutable chunk contracts and checks it against PAGE_HASH. The steward can append one successor version, which latest() follows.

anonWeiTarget.description: Contract the name anon.wei resolves to in WNS, which anon.wei.limo serves.

anonWeiOwner.description: Owner of the name anon.wei in WNS.

entries.name: zEndpoints
entries.description: Owner-curated registry of service URLs per key and chain, which apps read at load to find their RPC nodes, relays and file mirrors.

relayHostEthereum.description: Relay host the anon.wei page uses on Ethereum ahead of its built-in one, unless the user sets a relay.

logNodesEthereum.description: RPC nodes the anon.wei page asks first for Ethereum history.

provingKeyMirrors.description: Mirrors the anon.wei page may fetch the proving key and witness program from, each checked against its pinned SHA-256.

entries.name: TacitEvmPoolRouter
entries.description: Periphery of one pool. It derives deposit and receive boxes, addresses anyone can pay and anyone can sweep into the pool as notes the owner fixed in advance, and runs withdrawals that call other contracts in the same transaction.

entries.name: TacitEvmPoolZap
entries.description: Swaps the caller's token for ETH through zRouter and deposits it into the pool with the caller's proof, in one transaction. It holds nothing between transactions.

entries.name: TransactVerifier
entries.description: Groth16 verifier for the transact circuit, with the verification key of its trusted setup hard-coded.

entries.name: TacitEvmPool
entries.description: Shielded pool for one asset. Each transaction carries one Groth16 proof that deposits, transfers inside the pool or withdraws, and inserts its new notes into a Poseidon tree the proof updates. It stores every root it has held and the spent nullifiers.

entries.name: TacitBox
entries.description: Implementation behind the router's boxes: clones at addresses fixed by each intent, which hold payments and release them only when the router instructs.

entries.name: PoseidonT5
entries.description: Four-input Poseidon hash from poseidon-solidity. The router computes the note of each receive box sweep with it.

entries.name: zRpcList
entries.description: Owner-curated list of Ethereum RPC URLs that apps read at load.
